enchantment.lemursaucepacket.telekinesis: Blocks you break and mobs you kill drop straight into your inventory (at your feet when it is full).
enchantment.lemursaucepacket.hardness.de: Lets a pickaxe break harder blocks. Each tier needs a Mining level: I iron, zinc and lapis; II gold and redstone; III diamond, emerald and obsidian; IV ancient debris; V reinforced deepslate and budding amethyst.
